coverageTarget: Replacement scientific workflow library must explicitly replace, reject, or supersede every row.

workflows.name: adversarial-dev
workflows.purpose: Build a new application through adversarial planner, generator, and evaluator roles.

nodeShape.topology: Linear plan -> workspace initialization -> state-machine sprint loop -> report.

workflows.description: Turns an application idea into a sprint-based build whose implementation is repeatedly challenged against explicit quality thresholds.

workflows.name: architect
workflows.purpose: Find and implement targeted codebase architecture simplifications.

nodeShape.topology: Linear metrics scan -> analysis -> plan -> changes -> validation/fix -> pull request verification.

workflows.description: Measures codebase hotspots, plans high-value simplifications, applies them with review hooks, validates the result, and prepares a pull request.

workflows.name: assist
workflows.purpose: Provide a general fallback when no specialized workflow matches.
outputs: Agent response and any requested workspace changes

nodeShape.topology: Single delegated general-assistance node.

workflows.description: Handles questions, debugging, exploration, explanations, and one-off work through a general-purpose agent.

workflows.name: comprehensive-pr-review
workflows.purpose: Run a broad pull-request review and automatically address severe findings.

nodeShape.topology: Scope/sync prefix -> five-way review fan-out -> synthesis -> fix implementation.

workflows.description: Synchronizes a pull request, runs five specialized reviews in parallel, consolidates their findings, and fixes the highest-severity issues.

workflows.name: create-issue
workflows.purpose: Reproduce a reported bug before creating a well-evidenced issue.
outputs: Failure report or drafted and created issue

nodeShape.topology: Classification -> parallel context gathering/server setup -> reproduction -> cleanup/gate -> failure report or issue draft/create branch.

workflows.description: Investigates and attempts to reproduce a bug, creating an issue only when the reproduction gate succeeds.

workflows.name: feature-development
workflows.purpose: Implement an already-written feature plan.
inputs: Implementation plan path or planned issue

nodeShape.topology: Linear implementation -> pull request -> base verification.

workflows.description: Executes an existing feature plan, validates the implementation, and prepares a correctly based pull request.

workflows.name: fix-github-issue
workflows.purpose: Investigate, implement, validate, review, and report a fix for an issue.

nodeShape.topology: Issue extraction/classification -> research plus investigate/plan branches -> implementation/validation -> pull request -> five-way review fan-out -> synthesize/fix/simplify/report.

workflows.description: Carries a tracked issue from classification and research through implementation, validation, adaptive review, remediation, and final reporting.

workflows.name: idea-to-pr
workflows.purpose: Take a feature idea through planning, implementation, validation, and comprehensive review.

nodeShape.topology: Linear plan/setup/implement/validate/PR prefix -> five-way review fan-out -> synthesis/fixes -> summary.

workflows.description: Converts a feature idea into an implementation plan, code, validation evidence, a pull request, and a consolidated post-review result.

workflows.name: interactive-prd
workflows.purpose: Create product requirements through staged human-guided discovery.

nodeShape.topology: Linear discovery/research/technical stages separated by three human approval gates, followed by generation and validation.

workflows.description: Guides a user from problem framing through research, technical scope, approval gates, and a validated requirements document.

workflows.name: issue-review-full
workflows.purpose: Fix an issue and subject the resulting change to a full multi-specialist review.

nodeShape.topology: Investigate/implement prefix -> pull-request verification/sync -> five-way review fan-out -> synthesis/fixes/summary.

workflows.description: Combines issue investigation and implementation with a comprehensive parallel review, remediation pass, and final decision summary.

workflows.name: piv-loop
workflows.purpose: Run human-guided plan, implement, and validate cycles for one bounded change.
inputs: Feature or bug description, plan path, or issue number

nodeShape.topology: Linear explore loop -> plan/refinement loop -> setup/implementation loop -> review/fix-feedback loop -> finalize/verify.

workflows.description: Uses iterative human feedback to explore, plan, implement, review, repair, and finalize one granular feature or bug fix.

workflows.name: plan-to-pr
workflows.purpose: Execute an existing implementation plan through a reviewed pull request.

nodeShape.topology: Plan setup/confirmation -> implementation/validation/PR -> five-way review fan-out -> synthesis/fixes -> summary.

workflows.description: Checks an existing plan, implements and validates it, prepares a pull request, and resolves findings from a comprehensive review.

workflows.name: ralph-dag
workflows.purpose: Implement product stories iteratively from an idea or requirements files.
inputs: Idea, requirements Markdown, or requirements JSON

nodeShape.topology: Input detection -> conditional requirements generation -> validation -> story implementation loop -> pull-request verification -> report.

workflows.description: Normalizes an idea into story-oriented requirements when needed, iterates through story implementation, and reports the resulting pull request.

workflows.name: refactor-safely
workflows.purpose: Refactor while continuously checking type safety and behavioral preservation.

nodeShape.topology: Linear scope scan -> read-only impact analysis -> plan -> hooked edits -> validation/fix -> behavior verification -> PR verification.

workflows.description: Scopes and plans a refactor, applies it with checks after edits, verifies behavior, and prepares a pull request with before-and-after evidence.

workflows.name: remotion-generate
workflows.purpose: Generate or modify a Remotion composition and render its media.

nodeShape.topology: Linear project check -> composition generation -> preview render -> video render -> summary.

workflows.description: Writes a requested Remotion composition, renders preview frames and the final video, then summarizes the generated output.

workflows.name: resolve-conflicts
workflows.purpose: Resolve pull-request merge conflicts with escalation for ambiguous cases.
outputs: Resolved conflict commit or human decision request

nodeShape.topology: Single delegated conflict-resolution node.

workflows.description: Analyzes merge conflicts, automatically resolves clear cases, and presents choices when intent is ambiguous.

workflows.name: smart-pr-review
workflows.purpose: Adapt pull-request review depth to the change's scope and complexity.

nodeShape.topology: Scope/sync/classify prefix -> conditional five-way review fan-out -> synthesis/fixes -> optional notification branch.

workflows.description: Classifies a pull request, invokes only relevant review specialists, consolidates the findings, and fixes critical or high-severity issues.

workflows.name: test-loop-dag
workflows.purpose: Demonstrate and test loop-node completion behavior.

nodeShape.topology: Linear setup -> bounded counter loop -> report.

workflows.description: Initializes a counter, iterates it to a fixed completion threshold, and reports successful loop execution.

workflows.name: validate-pr
workflows.purpose: Compare main and feature behavior to validate that a pull request fixes the target problem.

nodeShape.topology: Parallel PR fetch/port allocation -> path resolution and sequential branch reviews -> testability gate -> main/feature E2E chain -> cleanup -> final report.

workflows.description: Reviews and tests both sides of a pull request, checking that the baseline exhibits the problem and the feature branch resolves it before issuing a verdict.

workflows.name: workflow-builder
workflows.purpose: Generate and validate a custom workflow definition from a user request.
inputs: Existing project commands, workflows, and package context

nodeShape.topology: Linear codebase scan -> intent extraction -> YAML generation -> structural validation -> save/report.

workflows.description: Examines project context, translates a request into a workflow graph, validates the generated definition, and saves it for project use.
